name: Drata
description: Drata's MCP server allows automating all aspects of GRC covering the full lifecycle of controls, policies, risks, evidence, frameworks, vendors, personnel, and devices directly inside the Drata platform.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Drata to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Drata to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.drata.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Drata MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drata lists 36 MCP tools, including Drata_createControl, Drata_createEvidence, Drata_createRisk, Drata_createVendor, Drata_deleteEvidence, Drata_deleteEvidenceArtifact, Drata_deleteRisk, Drata_deleteVendor, Drata_getCompany, Drata_getEvidence, Drata_getVendor, and Drata_listDevices.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Drata?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Drata in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Drata requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Drata is developed by Drata Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
